items.title: Research acceleration: The view inside OpenAI
items.title_zh: OpenAI 披露编程代理正推动研究加速迈向递归自我改进
items.title_en: OpenAI Reveals Coding Agents Fuelling Research Push Toward Recursive Self-Improvement
items.summary: OpenAI discusses research acceleration and Recursive Self-Improvement, revealing how coding agents have reshaped their researchers' daily work.

items.title: 最高法发布 AI 纠纷司法解释，换脸与算法杀熟等责任获明确
items.title_zh: 最高法发布人工智能纠纷司法解释，厘清AI责任
items.title_en: China's Top Court Issues Landmark Judicial Interpretation on AI Dispute Liability
items.summary: China's Supreme People's Court issues a 24-article judicial interpretation clarifying legal liability for AI disputes, including deepfakes, algorithmic price discrimination, and unauthorized AI impersonation.

items.title: 216M Spy TVs – The LG Smart TV Problem [video]
items.title_zh: LG智能电视被曝偷录音频并扫描局域网设备
items.title_en: LG Smart TVs Are Caught Logging Audio and Snooping on Devices
items.summary: A video and report detail how LG Smart TVs engage in invasive data collection, including audio logging with screen off and local device snooping, drawing widespread community concern.

items.title: TPU Inference Externalization Full Steam Ahead - InferenceX
items.title_zh: TPU经InferenceX加速外部化，削弱英伟达CUDA护城河
items.title_en: TPU Externalization via InferenceX Gains Steam, Eroding Nvidia's CUDA Moat
items.summary: Covers the rapid externalization of Google's TPU stack via InferenceX, offering up to 50% better performance per dollar and challenging NVIDIA's CUDA dominance.

items.title: Rustuna: A High-Performance Rust Implementation of Optuna [P]
items.title_zh: Rustuna：高性能的 Optuna Rust 实现发布
items.title_en: Rustuna: High-Performance Rust Implementation of Optuna Released
items.summary: Rustuna is a new high-performance, memory-efficient Rust implementation of Optuna with a compatible API and zero Python dependencies.

items.title: LLM-guided program evolution improves 10 best-known circle-packing solutions (Packomania csqv, N=101-114) [R]
items.title_zh: LLM进化出的优化算法打破10项圆形填充纪录

items.summary: An LLM-guided program evolution method improves 10 best-known circle-packing solutions on the Packomania csqv benchmark for N=101-114 at a total cost of $27.72.

items.title: 📱 华为时隔六年再次发布高性能芯片
items.title_zh: 华为时隔六年发布全新麒麟高性能芯片

items.summary: Huawei releases the Kirin 9050 Pro chip with logic folding technology, marking its first new high-performance chip in six years.
